body:
Fixes #1165

Theme assembly for the egress dial: three bot-gated child PRs already merged into
`goal/1162-egress`, landing on master as **one** PR. 3 commits, 19 files.

## Coverage map

| child | outcome | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| #1056 — egress dial never reached reviewer/prober/coordinator pods; loop + `agent-coordinator` namespaces carry no CNP | **owned** | PR #1196 — new `agents/coordinator/egress-cnp.yaml` (+kustomization), the `argocd/resources/agentstack/composition.yaml` render, and the `AgentWorkerEgressDropped` regex widened to `agent-coordinator` + `.*-agents` |
| #107 — `registry.npmjs.org` is a silent SYN black-hole on homelab rides under enforced egress | **owned** | PR #1168 — `hostAliases` stub for **every** harness (not just opencode) when egress is enforced without a `node` profile, so the drop fails fast (RST) instead of wedging to the 4h deadline; pinned by the new `opencode-hostaliases/enforced-non-opencode` replay row |
| #1180 — `deploy-revert` clones and pushes the `-iac` repo anonymously (private `oracle-iac` unclonable; a #1136 throttling site) | **owned** | PR #1184 — broker token embedded in the clone/push URL, pinned by the `deploy-revert-token-clone` set/unset replay rows |
| #1189 — goal-lane reviews run with the ADR-097 footprint belt off (`closingIssuesReferences` is empty off the default branch) | **deferred to a named, already-merged PR: #1191 (`de6583e`, master)** | see below |

Open-descendant walk of #1165 at PR-open time: **empty** — all four CLOSED, re-read immediately
before this PR was opened.

### Why #1189 is not in this diff

#1189 is a depth-2 descendant of this theme by lineage (its native parent is #1180), but its
`Touches:` — `agents/reviewer-session.sh` — falls outside this theme's declared `Surface:`, so the
intake rule refused it and it was ruled master-lane. It landed on master via PR #1191 on 2026-09-01
(3 logic rounds, 2 of them `ci-red` on the ADR-103 pin ratchet). Named here explicitly rather than
rediscovered as a stray descendant at PR-open time: had it still been open, the depth-agnostic
completion walk would have blocked this ruling.

### Surface honesty

Three paths in this diff sit outside the theme's declared `Surface:` line
(`argocd/resources/agentstack/composition.yaml, agents/agent-session.sh, agents/coordinator/*.yaml`):

- `agents/replay/**` — the fixtures pinning the two fixes above. Test coverage for in-surface code.
- `argocd/resources/pushgateway/prometheusrule.yaml` — #1056's alert-regex widening. The dial and
  the alert that watches it are one deliverable; shipping the CNPs without the regex would leave
  the new namespaces unwatched.
- `agents/coordinator/deploy-revert-argo.yaml` — in-surface by the `agents/coordinator/*.yaml` glob,
  but topically unrelated to egress: #1180 joined this theme on the file-prefix test alone. Recorded
  as a pilot readout datapoint, not hidden here.

### Not in scope

- **The enforce flip.** These CNPs are **monitor-mode only**; flipping to enforce is explicitly
  excluded and stays a separate, human-gated change.
- Naming the process that issues the `registry.npmjs.org` calls (~2.4k `POLICY_DENIED`/24h). #1168
  fixed the *hang*, not the *caller* — the caller needs a cluster-access ride and is tracked
  separately.

## Checks

CI was green on each child PR into this branch. This PR re-runs against master. `/agents/` is
codeowned, so this needs a **human codeowner approval** in addition to the bot review and green CI —
one codeowner touch for three children, which is the batching this pilot is measuring.

## Production leg

The soak runs **after** this merges — the code is not live until master deploys. Watch for 48h:
monitor-mode CNPs rendered in the loop namespaces, and the Hubble harvest returning expected flows
with no `POLICY_DENIED` from loop namespaces beyond the known npm traffic above.
